hooks.name: Ghi log CHANGELOG khi xóa file trong src/

action.prompt: A file in src/ was just deleted. Please append a changelog entry to docs/CHANGELOG.md documenting the deletion. Use format: `- [HH:MM] Xóa \`<relative_path>\` — <reason if inferable, otherwise "removed">`. Group under today's date heading if it already exists, otherwise create a new date heading `## [YYYY-MM-DD]` with a `### Xóa` subsection. Keep the entry concise (1 line).
